content.instructions: A separable verb puts “ge-” between the prefix and the stem: “aufgestanden”. Verbs with an unstressed prefix (“be-, ver-, ent-, er-”) and verbs in “-ieren” have no “ge-”: “besucht, verstanden, studiert”.
